subject: english
title: Nouns — Practice
description: A short timed practice quiz with hints and answer explanations.

questions.question: Which word is a proper noun?
questions.hint: A proper noun names a specific person or place.

options.feedback: Correct. Chennai is the specific name of a city.

questions.explanation: Chennai is a specific place name, so it is a proper noun.

questions.question: In 'The girl opened the book', which word is a common noun for a thing?
questions.hint: Look for the object being opened.

options.feedback: Girl is a common noun for a person.

questions.explanation: Book is a common noun that names a thing.

questions.question: Which statement is true?
questions.hint: Recall the difference between common and proper nouns.

options.text: Proper nouns usually begin with a capital letter in English.

options.feedback: Nouns and verbs have different roles.

options.text: A common noun always names one specific person.
options.feedback: That describes a proper noun more closely.
Nouns can name ideas such as kindness.

questions.explanation: Proper nouns identify specific names and normally begin with a capital letter in English.
